derivedInput: Original headset PCM within all own annotated utterances plus150ms each side; outside replaced with exact zero; original full duration retained. All four people, no chosen best cases.
score: Same full per-person references, strict original normalization. Report all S/D/I; compare raw/conditioned same person only.
scope: Diagnostic estimate with known target activity and a close headset, not automatic activity, source separation, holdout or sale qualification.
stopDecision: One fixed construction, no padding/gain/threshold search. Persistent errors with known activity identify remaining ASR/content problems; a gain only proves the importance of target presence, not an automatic solution.
timingLimits: TextGrid is not sample-exact clean-source truth; padding is fixed before inference and does not establish SDR/alignment qualification.
